title: “Math 2.0” will need to value mathematical progress more holistically
summary: A discussion sparked by Terence Tao's Mathstodon post arguing that mathematics should value progress more holistically, rather than focusing narrowly on theorem-proving or problem-solving. The Hacker News thread explores how AI/ML tools are reshaping mathematical research, including formal verification, automated conjecture, and collaboration, and debates what counts as meaningful mathematical advancement in the 'Math 2.0' era.
